events.title: 😺 RoboCat Café NEW DEMO will be on Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hello Cyber Angel! 🪽 I have exciting news!RoboCat Café new DEMO will be available at Steam Next Fest in a week on 😻Oct 19! 😻After the playtest some new features were added:Resting - after working hard the kitties might get tired and will refuse to meet clients. You must have enough scratching posts in the café so they can recover. Different cats have different tolerance.Cleaning - customers can leave a little mess behind, so swipe their tables back and forth to allow for new customers to come in
